learning_outcomes.text: Systematizing, assimilating and increasing students’ theoretical and practical knowledge.
Checking the students’ ability for independent creative decision of engineer tasks.

syllabus_topics: Scheme compilation for management of upswing-transporting machines
Scheme compilation for industrial technological processes
Scheme compilation for agricultural technological processes
Scheme compilation for food industry technological processes
Scheme compilation for metal cutting machines

assessment_methods.method: Defence (oral and presentation) of the course project

assessment_rules: The project assignment is proposed at the beginning of the semester. Every week students must present the reached stage of work. The course project must be submitted in the last week of the semester and, after being checked by the lecturer, it must be defended.
